_pack: dnksubastas Noticias — monthly per-province recap prose template pack
_how_to_use: One article = TITLE + META + [opening] + [outcome] + [price] + [rank] + [closing]. Insert [low_activity] instead of outcome+price+rank when the low_activity gate fires.
Each slot is a dict of CONDITION -> list of interchangeable variants. Evaluate the condition, then pick a variant from that list deterministically.

Deterministic pick: idx = seeded_hash(province_slug + period + slot_name) % len(variants). Use a DIFFERENT slot_name per slot so the same province doesn't land on the same array index in every slot (which would read patterned).
Variants are written to compose in ANY combination and read natural regardless of order-neighbours. No variant assumes what the previous sentence said.
es and en arrays are index-parallel in COUNT only, NOT in meaning — pick each language independently by its own seed; do not force the same index across languages.

_placeholders._note: Python fills these PRE-FORMATTED strings/numbers. Keys map to statsJson + derived values.
_placeholders.{mes_anterior}: previous month name localized ('mayo' / 'May') — only used in opening.up/down/flat
_placeholders.{nuevas}: intake (int). PLURALIZATION: when intake==1 Python must swap the noun to singular ('nueva subasta'/'new auction'). Templates below assume plural; see _pluralization.
_placeholders.{pct_vendidas}: round(sold/totalConcluded*100) — Python computes; omit slot if totalConcluded==0
_placeholders.{precio_mediano}: format_eur(soldMedianCents) -> '12.500 €' (es) / '€12,500' (en). Honest label = median HAMMER/adjudication price over sold lots.
_placeholders.{descuento}: abs(discountAppraisalMedian) as integer percent (e.g. 34) — framed 'por debajo de la tasación'
_placeholders.{mom_pct}: abs(round(momIntakeDeltaPct)) integer percent — only in opening.up/down
_placeholders.{rank}: rankByIntake (int, national rank by intake, 1 = most active)

_pluralization._rule: When a count == 1, prefer variants that read fine in singular, or let Python substitute the singular noun. Most variants below phrase the noun once, right after its number, to make substitution trivial.

_conditions.opening: no_prior (momIntakeDeltaPct is null) | up (momIntakeDeltaPct >= +5) | down (<= -5) | flat (between -5 and +5)
_conditions.outcome: zero_concluded (totalConcluded==0 -> DON'T use this slot, low_activity covers it) | all_sold (desierta==0 and sold>0) | all_desierta (sold==0 and desierta>0) | normal (both >0)
_conditions.price: normal (sold >= 5 and soldMedianCents not null) | suppressed (sold < 5 or soldMedianCents null)
_conditions.low_activity: USE INSTEAD of outcome+price+rank when intake < 3 AND totalConcluded < 3. (Ceuta/Melilla and dead months land here.)
